79.
(1) A person holding securities in acompany listed
on a stock exchange shall not buy, sell, gift or otherwise deal
in  such  securities  off  the  trading  floor  without  the  prior
approval of the Commission except in compliance with the
trading procedure adopted by such stock exchange.
(2) A person as referred to in subsection (1) may gift any
such  securities  to  a  relation  otherwise  than  in  compliance
with such trading procedure if he gives prior notice to the
Commission and the exchange of the particulars relating to
the proposed gift.
(3)    In  this  section  “relation”  means  a  parent,  spouse,
child  (including  step  children)  or  sibling  (including  step
brother or step sister) of that person or the spouse of a child
of that person.
